bugs.symptoms: Suggested credit on dispute dsp_1043 is $400.00. The Scale invoice is $249.00.
bugs.linearTitle: Suggested credit on dsp_1043 shows $400 instead of the $249 Scale cap

bugs.description: Status pills write state= while the invoice and dispute pages read status, so Overdue and Needs review do not change the queue.
bugs.symptoms: Clicking Overdue or Needs review does not filter the list.
bugs.linearTitle: Clicking Overdue or Needs review does not filter the queue

bugs.description: Dashboard aging uses the issue date, so open invoices that are not due yet count as overdue. The count disagrees with the Overdue queue and shares the invoice-filter fingerprint.
bugs.symptoms: The dashboard overdue count is higher than the Overdue queue.
bugs.linearTitle: Dashboard overdue count includes invoices that are not due yet

bugs.description: Resolving an accepted or declined dispute posts the catalog credit again and reports the failure to Sentry with the customer attached.
bugs.symptoms: Dispute dsp_1050 was already accepted, and the $99.00 Growth credit posted a second time. The resolve call errors.
bugs.linearTitle: Resolving accepted dispute dsp_1050 posts the Growth credit again
